description: Mobilité - Comptages vélos secteur Mignaloux CHU - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Bicycle counting data, with meaning discrimination. Permanent counter installed on the bidirectional bike path Mignaloux /CHU (Sector Beaubaton). The dataset presents all the daily passages by direction. The table structure will be changed when the National Standard is adopted. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Mobility - Bicycle counting sector Mignaloux CHU - Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include mobilité, vélos, vélo, piste cyclable, comptages. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
